# iosxe_wireless_mesh_profile (Data Source)

This data source can read the Wireless Mesh Profile configuration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "iosxe_wireless_mesh_profile" "example" {
  profile_name = "S1-MESH-OUTDOOR"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `profile_name` (String) This value indicates the name of Mesh profile

### Optional

- `device` (String) A device name from the provider configuration.

### Read-Only

- `convergence_method` (String) This value indicates Convergence method used in the Mesh Access Points
- `description` (String) This value indicates the name of the Mesh profile description
- `id` (String) The path of the retrieved object.
- `multicast_mode` (String) This value indicates the multicast mode over mesh network for Ethernet bridged multicast traffic
- `range` (Number) This value indicates the maximum range between outdoor root and mesh Access Points
- `security_mode` (String) This value indicates the security method used for Mesh Access Points
